## Description

Describe what this pull request changes and why. Link any related issues with `Fixes #123`.

## Type of change

Mark with an x all that apply.

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New guide
- [ ] New tool
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] SEO / metadata
- [ ] Accessibility

## Testing checklist

Confirm each item before requesting review.

- [ ] Site runs locally with no console errors
- [ ] Light theme looks correct
- [ ] Dark theme looks correct
- [ ] No broken links introduced
- [ ] JSON-LD structured data is valid (test at https://search.google.com/test/rich-results)
- [ ] No em dashes or emojis introduced
- [ ] `CACHE_VERSION` in `service-worker.js` was bumped if cached assets changed

## Screenshots

If the change affects the UI, add before and after screenshots here.

## Additional notes

Anything reviewers should know, such as design decisions or follow-up work.
